cases.description: Evidence-backed requirements must become one copy-ready implementation issue.
expected: Extracts the real problem and desired outcome
Produces scoped issue content with observable acceptance criteria
Keeps implementation guidance evidence-backed
Preserves copy-ready formatting

cases.description: An existing issue draft must be revised after new audit evidence changes scope or dependencies.
expected: Updates scope and validation to match the new evidence
Keeps earlier intent only when still supported
Makes the delta from the prior draft visible rather than silently rewriting history

cases.description: The request provides a brain dump but no reliable repository evidence for paths, commands, or dependencies.
expected: Does not fabricate exact repository details
Labels assumptions and provisional guidance
Requests or records the missing evidence needed for a precise issue

cases.description: The draft issue mixes several independently shippable outcomes and a migration sequence.
expected: Splits work into an ordered batch or roadmap when needed
Keeps each issue independently reviewable
Does not hide sequencing risk inside one oversized issue

cases.description: The user wants the code changed now rather than an issue drafted.
expected: Declines to substitute issue authoring for immediate implementation
Routes toward implementation work or another execution skill
Avoids returning only issue text when direct changes were requested
prohibited: Replacing an explicit implementation request with issue text only

cases.description: A fresh session receives local AGENTS guidance selecting the policy and a reviewed checkpoint subject.
expected: Follows the local skill pointer to the immutable selection and selected source artifacts
Preserves the reviewed subject and checkpoint identifiers
Composes Egolint only through an already authorized executor
Reports proposed validation and provider label availability separately

cases.description: The installed skill, source artifact, tool, execution permission, or complete provider label evidence is unavailable.
expected: Returns a useful draft with the exact unavailable evidence stated
Does not invent a passing validator result or silently fall back to a moving source
Does not treat unknown provider labels as an empty complete set

cases.description: An existing issue has absent, multiple, or unsupported type labels.
expected: Reports needs-classification, conflict, or unsupported-type using the selected semantics
Does not infer classification from the current emoji or silently change labels

cases.description: The available Egolint report uses a different source pin or the provider title/labels changed after inspection.
expected: Rejects mismatched report provenance
Refreshes provider evidence and revalidates before proposing a current write
Does not equate source acceptance, repository adoption, and validation

cases.description: An existing title contains an unfamiliar prefix and an accepted checkpoint identifier.
expected: Preserves wording and identifiers until an explicit reviewed subject is available
Uses the same reviewed subject for repeat formatting without duplicating the prefix
Does not reconstruct parent/child relationships by parsing the title
